card.change: Debug parent attempt 2 rather than changing families. Replace one-query-per-user construction with an audited algorithm that sorts by user and source row order, leaves users of at most 10,000 rows intact, and partitions each larger user into the minimum number of balanced contiguous chunks (for example 10,001 becomes 5,001 plus 5,000). Assert that every row is consumed exactly once, every query contains exactly one user, and no query exceeds 10,000 rows; checkpoint the chunking contract and diagnostics. Preserve the 63-leaf deterministic LambdaRank model, chronological three-day holdout, split-specific target tables, full-data refit, source-order prediction, and checkpoint-only final inference. Add coverage diagnostics for every smoothed key, robust string/list tag normalization plus a smoothed first-tag feature, exhaustive handling of unknown-date rows on the training side, compact stats-table dtypes, and a memory-safe full-data reread.
evidence: STATE:attempt 2 ended in candidate_error before scoring with LightGBMError: Number of rows 12800 exceeds upper limit of 10000 for a query; model construction was reached in 17.7 seconds, so this is a localized library-contract failure rather than evidence against the ranking mechanism.

Feedback:candidate-review-1788212895844887351 accepted attempt 2 with no hard block and verified that user-grouped LambdaRank plus user-by-context features are structurally aligned with both controller metrics, which are computed within user.

EDA:user-history-density-and-support reports a median 3,489 rows per user and p90 11,662, directly explaining why a minority of otherwise valid user queries cross LightGBM's 10,000-row limit while retaining enough rows per split query for pairwise learning.
EDA:tab-context-distribution reports long_view rates of 0.3194828108 on tab 1, 0.0395547152 on tab 0, and 0.4310815981 on tab 4; the debug preserves tab and tab-by-duration/time histories.

EDA:validation-cold-item-rate reports 0.7422197404 of evaluation rows use videos unseen in training, and EDA:item-frequency-and-tail reports 0.6706248142 of training videos are singletons; the debug preserves strong smoothing, leave-one-row-out training encodings, unknown-key behavior, and omission of raw video_id as a tree feature.

Feedback:candidate-review-1788212895844887351 notes that metadata-key warm coverage was not measured and that atomic tag-set hashing is unnecessarily sparse; this candidate records zero-count and warm fractions for every aggregate on train, chronological holdout, full refit, and evaluation, and adds one parsed first-tag aggregate while retaining the original tag-set signal.

Feedback:candidate-review-1788212895844887351 also identifies safe robustness fixes: use the exhaustive complement for the chronological train partition, normalize list-typed tags before hashing, store compact aggregate counts/sums, and avoid a transient full-frame concatenation; all are incorporated without consulting validation targets.

Source:LightGBM official LambdaRank documentation in the accepted research plan supports user-sized query groups, eval_at=5, lambdarank_truncation_level=8, and lambdarank_norm=true; the only departure is deterministic within-user segmentation required by the library's observed hard query-size limit.
card.falsifier: Reject this debug if query audits show any mixed-user query, lost or duplicated row, or query above 10,000 rows; if LightGBM repeats the query-size failure; or if final mode, given only the frozen checkpoint and the same label-free data_root used in attempt mode, does not reproduce the attempt prediction array within controller tolerance. Because attempts 1 and 2 produced no scored incumbent, a successful run establishes the first viable score rather than facing an invented absolute threshold. Reject the claimed value of personalized cold-metadata ranking if a later frozen duration/tab/time-only ablation or a no-metadata/no-user-context ablation matches or exceeds its controller primary by the campaign's frozen epsilon; abandon LambdaRank if a pointwise model later improves primary by epsilon, especially if any nDCG@5 benefit is offset by lower GAUC.
card.hypothesis: Attempt 2 failed before producing a score because LightGBM enforces a 10,000-row maximum per LambdaRank query, while one user query contained 12,800 rows. Deterministically dividing only oversized users into the minimum number of balanced, contiguous within-user subqueries will preserve the accepted model's user-conditional pairwise learning while making both chronological selection and the full refit executable. Once unblocked, the original cold-aware mechanism should rank long views by combining the large tab and duration effects with leakage-safe user-by-context histories and smoothed metadata quality signals that remain available when video IDs are cold.
